budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Move each role's actual cart from the western bank to its matching eastern goal, while deciding whether to pool construction resources, share bridges, maintain access or pursue toll income.
task.natural_termination: All three carts delivered ends naturally. A cart delivery rewards its owner +1 and each other role +0.25. A crossing of another role's owned bridge transfers 1/32 reward from traveler to owner. Otherwise truncate at step 128.
task.interaction: Any role may use a live bridge. Entering wears it by one, or two when hauling a cart; depleted occupied remnants permit departure but block new entry. Ownership allocates real payoff transfers, while maintenance, public access, shared depots and material handoffs change others' later route opportunities.
task.observation_access: All terrain, bridge states and ownership, cargo positions, worker resources, depot stock and goal identities are public. Entity visibility is true for all roles. Public observation contains the entire dynamic infrastructure state and net toll ledgers.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Indices 0 to 6: new bridge built, bridge repaired, wood transferred, bridge salvaged, toll waived, a toll paid, a cart delivered; flags refer to the most recent nonterminal transition.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
